India extend dominance over Pakistan with Pro League win
India opened the London leg of their FIH Pro League European tour with a thrilling 4-3 victory over arch-rivals Pakistan on June 23. The victory moved India up to the seventh position in the points table and was studded with goals from Abhishek (22’), Nilakanta Sharma (24’), Sukhjeet Singh (40’), and Rajinder Singh (52’)
